newsitem.title: GERMANY: Metro under pressure after Spiegel report.
newsitem.headline: Metro under pressure after Spiegel report.

text.p: Shares in German retailer Metro AG extended recent losses on Monday after news magazine Spiegel reported prosecutors were investigating possible irregularities in Metro's share issue prospectus.
Metro shares tumbled by over six marks before recovering to stand down 2.90 marks at 127 marks by 0830 GMT on the IBIS electronic share exchange.

Spiegel said Cologne prosecutors were investigating a loss of 1.8 billion marks carried forward in the prospectus for its July listing by Metro and set against taxes. It said the carry-forward was not approved by financial authorities.
Spiegel also quoted finance director Klaus Wiegandt saying Metro had won verbal assurances from finance officials that the treatment of the loss would be fully approved.
Neither the Cologne prosecutors nor Metro were immediately available for comment.

Swiss-controlled Metro, formed out of a merger of three large German retail groups, has fallen well below its July debut price of 143 marks per share after the company revised down its original sales and profits forecasts.
